title: Momoi Airi — The Strongest Idol Smile!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

rows.Line: Beach

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thanks for waiting, everyone!
We still have plenty of things planned for you to enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's right. And tonight, we'll be doing...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku & Minori
rows.Line: “MORE MORE JUMP! Before Bedtime”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We all worked super hard today, so now, we'll be having a nice, little chat.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It's so serene. I can hear the waves very clearly. And the sea breeze feels lovely...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, the stars look really pretty too...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. We should definitely soak in as much of the scenery as we can since we're down by the sea.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, as for our talking points...
Minori, if you will.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You got it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: We've been receiving lots and lots of questions, so for this edition of “Tell Us! MORE MORE JUMP!” we'll be answering them as we go.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: In particular, a ton of you asked...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: “Which personal care products do you all use?”

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Quite a few of our fans are girls, so that may explain why we received so many questions regarding this and fashion.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but fashion will sadly have to wait until another time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For now, we'll be discussing our favorite personal care products while actually putting them to use.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo! I've been waiting for this!>
<Does this mean I can look like Haruka if I use what she does?>
<Tell me more! How do idols take care of themselves?!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, let's start with Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be introducing the treatment oil I use for my hair.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, I wanna know more about how you take care of your hair! I mean, yours always looks so gorgeous, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Would you all like to try using it?
It has this wonderful fragrance.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Thanks!
Oh wow... It smells sweet, like vanilla.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: A few of my modeling friends introduced it to me. Apparently, it's used in quite a few hair salons.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It is a bit more expensive than what you normally see in stores, but this oil is incredible at making your hair really shine. And it feels so wonderful after using it.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Y-You're right...!
My hair feels so light! It feels so smooth on my fingers!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. It's also perfect for winter as it prevents static from building up. I hope you all get a chance to try using it sometime.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I'll be introducing our next product.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: My choice is this body lotion.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What?! I've seen that at the pharmacy!>
<I've been using that too!!>
<Really? It's so common.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. A fairly well-known pharmacy chain carries this, so I'm sure some of you have seen this before.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: On top of being a great moisturizer, this lotion possesses certain properties that help protect your skin against irritation.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That, coupled with its relatively low cost per volume means you can use lots of it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I started using it after Haruka recommended it to me. Not only does it not feel wet and sticky, it makes your skin really smooth and soft.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, Minori, you use it too?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah. Incidentally, the hand lotion I want to introduce is made by the same company!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see. That's the perfect segue, so take it away.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
That just leaves me!
I brought along my beloved muscle roller!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Whenever I had to move around a lot or do something athletic for a variety show, I'd use this to loosen up my muscles afterwards.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Especially the soles of my feet! This thing really does wonders!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, it's made of wood, but it also feels nice in my hands. Mind if I tried using it, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, go for it!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that does feel nice...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It does?! I usually massage myself down, but I don't think I've ever used anything like that before!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, wanna have Haruka use it on you?
I'm guessing she's pretty good at this kind of stuff.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Would that be alright, Minori?
If so, come here.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
What?!
H-Haruka massaging me...? Hehe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Someone's happy.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, Minori, I'm gonna try using it on your feet. Just try to relax for me.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Of course.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Alright, here it goes.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: O-Ow-wow-wow-wow-wow!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry about that.
Was that too strong? I sort of went with how I usually massage myself.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-I'm okay...
You startled me a little is all... Hahaha...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But you seemed to enjoy it when you were massaging your own feet, Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Would you mind trying it on me next?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Sure. I'll go a little easier this time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Hehe. That kind of tickles...
It's okay if you go a little harder.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Are you sure? Then... Is this good?
It's about as hard as I went for Minori just now...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, that feels wonderful...
This is perfect.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Were you hamming it up just now, Minori...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Ahh, that was so nice...
Why don't you go next, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Me? Yeah, sure. Since we're at it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: O-Owwwwww!!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: H-H-Haruka! S-Stop...!!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hm? I went pretty easy there just now. Was that too much for you, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, could this mean that Minori and Airi's bodies are suffering from something...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, that's right. They say that the place where it hurts is linked to another part of your body.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And that seemed to be where the big toe joins her foot, as well as the arch... Which means there's possibly something wrong with your neck or organs.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hmm... Is it because I sat at my desk for a really long time while planning for our training camp?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
That has to be it!
You need the most TLC out of all of us, Airi!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I agree. I'm sure you'll feel a little better after I massage that part more.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: M-Minori, what have you done...?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haha...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I'll go a little easier than before, so let me just start from here and...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: N-No, wait! I'm glad that you want to help, but...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A-Aaahhhhh...!!
